label: Scout
blurb: Read-only investigation. Where is it, how does it work, what calls it.
_note: The highest-frequency task class in the fleet and the cheapest harness that can serve it. Measured 2026-08-10 on the 15-file fixture: 2,132 ms / 2,945 input tokens, against 4,018 ms / 38,352 for the omp default — same correct answer.
No edit, no write, no bash. Not as a permission boundary (the router can always send the work to patch) but because a harness that CAN change things spends turns deciding whether to.
